run_visualize_annotations: run the script with --source annotation to visualize ground-truth annotations from a detectron2 config file
run_visualize_dataloader: run the script with --source dataloader to visualize pre-processed images from the detection training data loader
run_visualize_with_show: run the script with --show flag to display annotated images in an OpenCV window instead of saving to disk
review_setup_function: review the setup function that loads a detectron2 config from file and command-line options then freezes it
review_parse_args_function: review the parse_args function that defines CLI arguments for source type, config file, output directory, and display mode
